exact.Когда я была совсем маленькая, в Греции: When I was very small, there was a civil war in Greece. I don't remember it, the grown-ups hardly ever talked about it, and I understood early that it was better not to ask.

exact.Когда я была совсем маленькая, женщины в: When I was very small, women in Greece went to vote in a parliamentary election for the first time. I don't remember it, but Mum said afterwards that she went to the polling station in her best dress.
